ground_truth_reference_answer: A Certificate of Compatibility is issued by the CPDO Zoning Enforcement Division to certify that proposed land activities are capable of co-existing harmoniously with adjacent zoning classifications. Requirements include: 1) Application Letter; 2) Zoning Certificate from CPDO; and 3) CTO Official Receipt. The filing fee is PHP 300.00, and the total administrative processing time is 1 Hour and 20 Minutes.

queries.english: What is the purpose, filing fee, and processing time of a CPDO Certificate of Compatibility?
queries.taglish: Para saan ang Certificate of Compatibility sa CPDO, magkano ang bayad, at gaano kabilis makuha?
queries.bislish: Para asa ang Certificate of Compatibility sa CPDO, pila ang filing fee, ug unsa kadugay ang pag-release?
